headline: Bitcoin climbed back above $60,000 on Wednesday afternoon as US stocks won back most of a morning sell-off, while hotter-than-expected inflation keeps a December Fed rate hike priced in.

market.asOf: Bitcoin from Yahoo Finance's live markets blog on the afternoon of Wed 25 Nov (US time); ether and solana from CoinDesk's price ticker at about 20:10 UTC 25 Nov. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 13 ("Extreme Fear") on Alternative.me's Crypto Fear & Greed Index and 9 on CoinMarketCap's Fear and Greed Index, read about 19:58 UTC 25 Nov.

stories.title: Wall Street wins back most of a tariff and AI sell-off; bitcoin returns above $60,000
stories.summary: US stocks fell sharply on Wednesday morning after the US proposed new tariffs on 14 economies and AI stocks sold off. By the afternoon most of that drop had reversed, and bitcoin, which has been moving closely with tech stocks, climbed back above $60,000.
points: At 2:24pm ET CoinDesk reported bitcoin back above $60,000 and up 0.2% over 24 hours, with the Nasdaq down 0.7%, the S&P 500 down 0.35% and the Dow up 0.6%.
Earlier, at 9:56am ET, the Nasdaq had been down 4.15%, about 20% below its record, per CoinDesk; bitcoin fell below $58,000, per The Block.
Nvidia was at $147.74, down 4.92%, at 3:08pm ET, per Yahoo Finance, after falling much further in the morning.
The tariffs the Trump administration proposed are not yet in force; a US official told Yahoo Finance they would probably come in January at the earliest.
US stocks had not closed when this was written; the market is shut on Thursday for Thanksgiving.

stories.title: Hot core inflation and a Beige Book showing sticky prices keep a December Fed rate hike as the base case
stories.summary: October's PCE report, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, came in a touch hotter than forecast, and the Fed's Beige Book survey of businesses described modest growth with wages and prices still rising. Higher interest rates tend to weigh on crypto.
points: Core PCE inflation was 3.3% on the year and headline PCE 3.8%, per Kiplinger; forecasters had expected 3.2% for core, per Yahoo Finance.

In the Beige Book, 8 of the 12 Fed districts grew at a slight to moderate pace and 4 were unchanged; prices rose moderately, with tariff-related costs among the pressures, per GSM Global News' summary.
The Atlanta Fed said cost pressures in its district showed few signs of easing.
CME FedWatch put the chance of a quarter-point hike at the 8-9 December meeting at 97.8% on 25 Nov, per MarketSpeaker. The decision is due at 2:00pm ET on 9 December.

stories.title: Fund outflows, forced selling and extreme fear: the pressure behind November's drop
stories.summary: Bitcoin funds keep losing money and companies that hold crypto are selling some of it to pay debts. Sentiment gauges are at 'extreme fear'.
points: US spot bitcoin funds lost $231.4 million on Tuesday 24 Nov, a sixth straight day of outflows, and ether funds lost $64.1 million, a seventh straight day, per CryptoNews. Wednesday's figures come after the US close.
The whole crypto market was worth $2.08 trillion, its lowest since September 2024, per The Block.
Bit Digital sold 29,825 ETH and repaid $50 million of a loan from Galaxy, per The Block; BTCS sold 27,300 ETH to repay Aave debt, per CoinDesk.
MSCI removes Strategy (MSTR) from its global indexes after the close on Monday 30 Nov, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Attackers hijack bitcoin miners' computing power
briefs.summary: Mining pool Braiins says attackers are rerouting miners' unencrypted connections so rewards go to them; up to 1.9 EH/s of hashrate was diverted and more than 1,000 sites were targeted on 20 Nov, per The Block.

briefs.title: Justice Department announces its largest-ever crackdown on crypto scam centers
briefs.summary: The DOJ says it targeted more than 800 defendants and froze more than $1 billion in stolen crypto, per The Block.

briefs.title: Coinbase Wallet lets US users take paychecks in USDC
briefs.summary: Users can receive all or part of a paycheck as USDC on Base with no deposit fee, up to $3,000 per deposit and $10,000 a day, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Nvidia agrees to pay $290 million over crypto-mining disclosures
briefs.summary: The class-action settlement over how Nvidia reported crypto miners' share of its 2017-18 gaming sales still needs court approval, per The Block.

briefs.title: Stablecoin issuers froze billions after the Binance hack
briefs.summary: Tether froze more than $1.5 billion of USDT within 30 minutes and Circle froze $1.1 billion of USDC after October's Binance hack, per Bloomberg, republished by Insurance Journal.
